en: Black-and-white panoramic view from a hillside or mountain over a lake, forested slopes, and a rural town with scattered farms and fields. In the foreground are trees on a slope; in the distance are rolling hills surrounding the water. White printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image, including a title, a number, a date, and a photographer/publisher credit.
